capabilities: Open the video associated with the active note in a reusable pop-out player
Seek to millisecond timestamps from note links with configurable pre-roll
Verify the local video file against a recorded SHA-256 identity
Locate the nearest timestamped evidence line from the player
Copy the current playback time as an Obsidian timestamp link
disambiguation: Not a transcription or note-generation tool; it only plays and navigates videos for notes that already follow its metadata contract.
extras: Windows 10/11 desktop only (Obsidian Desktop 1.11.7+). Notes must follow a specific frontmatter contract with matching SHA-256 file identity. UI is primarily Chinese; English localization is planned. No telemetry, accounts, or paid services.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a local video tied to a note and navigate between timestamp links and the matching moments in the video.

relations.evidence: The optional create-video-learning-notes Skill provides the other half of the workflow

summary: Timestamp-linked video note player that opens a note's local video in a pop-out window and jumps between timestamps and evidence lines.
